description: Restructure the profiled direct-source batch-2 n=4096 first rank-k around a legal rectangular 128-row 2x1 CuTe schedule and conflict-free padded or swizzled shared operands. Preserve the two independent graph chains and factor-only stagger while reducing the measured 230.40 KiB footprint, 1.8x/1.4x bank conflicts, and 81.5% no-eligible cycles across the full grid.

Wrapped local build passed because CuTe compilation is GPU-conditional, but Modal import failed before test0 because CuTe IntValue does not support Python divmod(rectangle_index, 2). No validation or benchmark metric was produced.

Wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed while preserving both independent graph chains and factor-only stagger.
